verdict.rationale: AngelList documents a first-party HRIS/payroll integration, configured under People > Configuration > Integrations. It explicitly terminates employees in AngelList automatically when they are terminated in the HRIS/payroll system, and terminations then update related securities on the cap table. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that new hires or stakeholder records sync automatically, a list of supported providers (e.g. Gusto, Rippling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
